mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a temperature of 46 degrees under clear skies at Verona City Hall, and a Waning Gibbous moon in the sky. If you are looking up tonight, the space station will be passing overhead starting at 5:51 PM, moving from the northwest near Verona High School toward the east southeast near Festival Foods.

The City of Verona has released candidate packets for the 2027 spring election. Candidates for all four aldermanic districts must file their declaration and nomination papers with the City Clerk by 5 PM on January 5, 2027.

Today is a great day to be out, with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and a 50-year anniversary celebration at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Crafty Fair at ART House 360 or catch more live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly report, on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a driver unresponsive in a vehicle, ultimately leading to an arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Snickers Swirl. The restaurant is currently open, so make sure to stop by before they close at 10:30 PM.
